question: When the series was adapted into anime, some smaller scenes were cut from the books. Were there any particular scenes that you really wanted to make sure were included?
answer:
I was allowed to participate in the anime script meetings, and I discuss things with the anime production staff such as which parts of each episode are important and so on.

For Season 4, the scene I specifically asked them to keep because “I really love this part, so please make absolutely sure you don't cut it” was the scene where Big Sis puts her finger into Subaru's mouth and makes him vomit. (※ Anime Season 4, Episode 69, “The Guardian of the Watchtower”)

And also the part where Ram makes him vomit everything and then says, “There, all better now, huh?” Kobayashi (Yusuke) was happy about it too. (Laughs) He's a Ram fan, so apparently he felt a certain “baby-mama” appeal from Big Sis. (Laughs)
